## 1900 - 1999

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="01900">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />1900 QRC - Low condensate</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="01900">

FLOWCAL will compare the Condensate on the current sample to the Condensate on the prior sample. An exception will be generated if the Condensate has decreased by more than the limit defined in the Radical Change validation for Condensate.

For example, the current sample has a Condensate value of 2.5. The limit defined in Radical Change validation for Condensate is 0.1. If the prior sample’s Condensate is greater than 2.6, then this exception will be generated.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="01901">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />1901 QRC - High full wellstream factor</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="01901">

FLOWCAL will compare the Full Wellstream Factor on the current sample to the Full Wellstream Factor on the prior sample. An exception will be generated if the Full Wellstream Factor has increased by more than the limit defined in the Radical Change validation for Full Wellstream Factor.

For example, the current sample has a Full Wellstream Factor value of 0.9875. The limit defined in Radical Change validation for Full Wellstream Factor is 0.01. If the prior sample’s Full Wellstream Factor is less than 0.9775, then this exception will be generated.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="01903">

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="01999">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />1999 Single run validation</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="01999">

Single Run Validation exceptions are related to the limits that are defined in the Meter Editor (Set-Up -\> Meter -\> Editor) for both Gas and Liquid Sources. Meter Single Run validations allow the user to specify whether to look for excessive variations, to compare the current record to the previous record or previous day, to compare using percentage or unit difference, when to compare, and minimum and maximum limits for each value, which serves as a tolerance level within which values will be treated as having excessive variation.

</div>

</div>
